verdict.rationale: Digits publishes an API reference covering ledger reads, financial statements, transaction sync, webhooks and bills workflows. It also documents an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and offers a free, resettable per-developer demo sandbox, so a developer can generate clients and test calls against realistic data. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive (e.g. 'try it' consoles) or ships runnable examples, and probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404 (the documented /openapi path was not probed). Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or copy-paste request examples in the reference, a verified reachable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
